{{Quote|Blast! The ELX-25 was only supposed to be in planning stages! If its operational, it could obliterate our base with a single shot.|Grand Moff Regus|<ref name="TOR-SUD">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|Shoring Up Defenses|Ilum}}</ref>}}
The '''ELX-25 prototype long-range cannon''' was a prototype weapon designed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to serve as a form of artillery during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. These long range weapons were deployed during planetary conflicts and were believed to be years before completion by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, the experimental cannon was deployed in [[Fort Salvo]] on the planet [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] when the world was facing conquest by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

At that time, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shai]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was responsible for calling the ELX-25 prototype into operation for testing. He ordered a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] to input the coordinates of the Imperial base after confronting an Imperial spacer. This shocked [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ilyan Regus]] who thought that the cannon was only in the planning stages. The Grand [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] managed to deduce the location of the cannon from its operational range and the source of Admiral Shai's transmission. Thus, he asked a Sith spacer with destroying the weapon. The Imperial then found the hidden control center for the cannon and set it to overload, destroying it.

==Behind the scenes==
The artillery is featured in the Ilum questline ''"Shoring Up Defenses"''.
